machine.note: This is the host that invoked the runner. GitHub `ubuntu-latest` / `macos-latest` weekly cron is not a named fixed benchmark machine (Issue #8 §8.2 / #12).

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_shapes_only_what_changed
invariants.note: Issue #99 static steady: only the ticking label reaches the shaper; the 999 still labels are skipped on their revisions.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_lays_out_only_what_changed
invariants.note: One new layout, the ticker's. A still label keeps the layout it holds.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_paint_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: The painter draws the layouts the Runtime retained, the ticker's new one included.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_rebuilds_only_what_changed
invariants.note: One label's text changes per frame. Every other paragraph must be answered by its retained entry. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_rasterizes_nothing
invariants.note: The ticker's digits are the only glyphs a steady frame can fault in, and only until it has seen all ten.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_uploads_no_atlas_region
invariants.note: Same bound, in bytes: a steady frame may fault a digit, never a page.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_moves_no_other_instance
invariants.note: Only the changed paragraph's block may reach the GPU. A thousand labels is about 120 KiB, so this fails closed on a whole-arena rewrite.

invariants.name: text_retained_steady_answers_nodes_from_entries
invariants.note: Nodes that reached a draw without resolving a glyph. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be read as 0.

scenario.notes: Issue #98 retained-text gate. One label changes per frame so the painter cannot answer from its prepared batch — which is what every frame beside an animation looks like. Work counters are the gate; the timings are host observation. Not Issue #8 weekly DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog.

mapping_notes: Loaded perf/scenarios/gpu-scene-text-retained.json and materialized its UiOnly params (viewport, host_texture slot, ui_nodes, node_repeat).
RuntimeDocument flush + HostTexture content slot + SceneWgpuPainter encode/submit. Not a private hosted-gpu-demo tree. No CPU readback.
gpu_upload_bytes counts observed queue.write_buffer on that path. NanaRenderer::text atlas uploads are reported separately as glyph_upload_bytes, not estimated into this one.
Batch / GpuUpload / Encode / Submit are FrameProfiler status=ran on the same encode/submit. Runtime-only drains keep those stages unsupported and omit GPU keys.
text_counters are per sampled frame: what one frame asked the retained-text path to resolve, rebuild and upload again.
